summary: Iter 220ea_30 — Tester cohort recruitment + spec-sheet inline edit + engineer_recruit social library. Backend: 5/5 PASS. Frontend partner engineer landing fully validated. SocialMediaLibraryPanel found to be ORPHAN (not wired into MasterAdminPage), so the 7 engineer_recruit posters cannot be viewed in the admin UI despite the backend serving them correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Component is defined but NOT imported anywhere in MasterAdminPage.js (or any other page). Backend exposes 7 engineer_recruit posts with valid image URLs and the static poster PNGs render at /marketing/engineer_recruit/post_0N.png (verified 200 image/png), but the admin user has no UI entry point to view them. The 'Social Media Library' panel needs to be added as a tab/route in MasterAdminPage.js.

action_items: Wire SocialMediaLibraryPanel into MasterAdminPage.js (add lazy import, sidebar nav entry e.g. 'Social Media Library', and case 'social-media-library' in renderPanel switch). Until then the engineer_recruit campaign is not visible to admins.
Optional: also surface a direct URL/tab for AdminSpecSheets so deep-linking from instructions like '/master-admin/spec-sheets' works (currently it is only reachable via Catalogue panel).
critical_code_review_comments: SocialMediaLibraryPanel.js is dead code from the user's POV — no consumer in the repo (grep confirms only its own self-export). Either wire it up or remove.

The /partners/engineers landing renders cleanly with Brand blue #2563EB → purple #9D4CDD gradient on key CTAs (no cyan observed). pe-tester-spaces correctly shows 'Only N of 10 tester spaces left' and '10-day free trial'. Both pe-hero-apply and pe-final-apply append cohort=tester to apply URL.

Public POST /api/partners/public-apply requires accept_terms (returns 400 'You must accept the Partner Engineer terms' if omitted); the frontend already handles this. Backend approve correctly propagates tester_cohort=true, sets trial_ends_at (~10 days), and creates subscription.status='trialing' with current_period_end.

success_rate.frontend: 67% (Partner Engineer landing OK; Master Admin Social Library orphan; Spec Sheet inline edit verified at backend + source level, browser exercise blocked by tab-only nav)

test_credentials: admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123! (used). One throwaway tester applicant created: tester.applicant+<epoch>@example.com — auto-approved, became partner_engineer with tester_cohort=true, trialing subscription. This consumed 1 of 10 tester spaces (remaining now 9).
seed_data_creation: 1 tester partner_engineer created from public-apply + master-admin approve flow. Tester spaces remaining reduced from 10 → 9 (expected per problem statement note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After fix: re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter_220ea_30_engineer_recruit.py and visually verify Master Admin → Social Media Library tab shows the 7 engineer_recruit posters with images rendering (naturalWidth>0). Also verify Spec Sheets inline edit in browser by going to Master Admin → Catalogue and clicking the pencil on a row (data-testid spec-edit-{id}, then spec-edit-model-{id} + spec-edit-save-{id}). Remember to restore the model name to its original value.
rca of the issue: SocialMediaLibraryPanel was authored as a standalone component but never registered as a tab in MasterAdminPage.js. The renderPanel switch in MasterAdminPage.js has cases for 'catalogue', 'social-autopilot', etc., but no 'social-media-library' / 'engineer_recruit_library' case, and no sidebar item points to it. Backend route GET /api/master-admin/social-media-library and the 7 PNG assets are all working — the gap is purely the missing frontend wire-up.
